inv-overworld.text:
OVERWORLD HUD: every element of GameMenu.tsx and board.tsx has a place

Moved:
- Menu button + waiting count -> the trainer corner (bottom left), so the keypad grows out of it.
- Egg badge (top right) -> a progress ring round the trainer corner, plus its steps under the name.
- Gold (bar) -> under the name in the trainer corner.
- Place and weather button + popover -> a capsule at bottom centre that opens into a card in place; the windows become a grid of six.
- Field-move chips -> round buttons bottom right, where the thumb is.
- Fullscreen (bar) -> top-right corner, its usual place.
- Keypad tiles -> three labelled columns of rows (You, Play, Inbox), counts on the right; Settings and theme in its footer.

New (proposal): the trainer's name in the corner.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-sheet.text:
CATCH SHEET: every element of sheet.tsx and its sections has a place

Moved:
- Nameplate (name, species, gender, shiny) -> a hero header with the name large and the level as a tag.
- Portrait, chips, stars, sigil, HP and statuses -> the hero, beside the portrait.
- Tera type and candy + Level Up -> hero tiles on the right, the two things raised from here.
- Badges -> the hero; box chip and Actions -> top right with a close button.
- Stats -> left column, with a hexagon of the totals over the table (IV, EV inputs, Remaining, Undo, Save kept).
- Moves -> the centre as cards in a 3-wide grid, since they are what a player builds around; Abilities and Held items under them.
- Evolution -> right column as a vertical line with Evolve.
- Dock (ball, history line, History n, Close) -> an Origin card; Close -> the header.

New (proposal): the hexagon; move cards show type, category, power and PP.
Dropped: nothing. Shadow and In a raid badges appear when they apply.

inv-battle.text:
BATTLE: every element of the battle view, top bar, unit card and verdict has a place

Moved:
- Side meters -> your side top left, the foe mirrored top right, standing counts as ball pips.
- Title (or Replay, Awards nothing, speeds) -> a centre nameplate with the speeds under it.
- Leave -> bottom right, still confirmed.
- Unit card -> stays on hover; pressing a pokemon docks it as an inspector on the right with Open sheet (today the press opens the sheet straight away).
- Verdict dialog -> a results screen over the field: result, line, rewards, both teams, Best as a podium, Stay and look, Leave battle.

New (proposal): the gold damage trail; the inspector step before the sheet.
Kept: countdown, status line, leave confirmation.

inv-raid.text:
RAID: same components as Battle

Moved:
- The boss's wide meter -> a banner at top centre with the boss's face, name (Frenzy for a Noble) and its share left; the raid's title sits above the name.
- Your side's meter -> a plate bottom left with its standing count.
- Leave -> bottom right.

Kept: the Noble's burst ring, red marks and stagger stars; an Alpha's copies.
Proposals (Show proposals): a kind badge, ticks at 3/4, 1/2, 1/4, a callout when one is passed.
Not drawn: a party list or a timer, which the game has not got.

inv-motion.text: MOTION: every tile is a proposal. Today the game has fades of 250ms (dialogs, popovers), toast in and out, cell notes, the ball land and shake, bar width transitions and the button press. Reduce motion stays as it is: everything cut to a moment.

inv-phone.text: PHONE: these three still show today's phone layouts. They get the same redesign pass next, following the desktop boards once those are agreed.

inv-box.text:
BOXES: every element of catches-list (index, heading, rail, actions, box-form, released), CatchGrid, CatchBox and CatchCard has a place

Moved:
- Dialog (64rem) -> the full sheet (76rem), the size of the catch sheet, so six squares a row get room.
- Summary line, New box and Select -> the top line; Done replaces both while selecting.
- Rail: Find a box, boxes (grip, swatch, name, count; Default first, built in), phone + chip, New box form, Let go today, the hint line and 'n of 32 boxes used' -> kept as the left rail.
- Box heading (swatch, name, Built in, fill line, Add pokemon, the ⋯ menu: rename, colour, lay out, close up, move all, delete, and their inline questions) -> one line over the box.
- Search, This box / All boxes, sort, order -> one row under it; the range line and the slot-order note share the line below.
- Selection strip (n selected, Move to, Favorite, Lock, Release twice with its candy price, Clear, held-back line) -> a green bar under the title.
- Squares: sprite, level, HP bar, egg walk bar, star and lock left, shiny and shadow right, fainted wash, picked tick, gaps dashed, box tag in All boxes.
- Hover card (CatchCard) and its verb; long-press on a phone; drag onto a box or a gap; Put here; Pick all.
- Dock: Close and the press note.

Kept as they are: the let-go list (opened from the rail), the Add to picker.
Proposals (Show proposals): a fill meter under each made box in the rail; a Picked tray under the box while selecting.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-picker.text:
CATCH PICKER and ITEM DIALOGS: no board of their own

- The catch picker (catch-picker/*) is the same grid, search row, squares and hover card as the Boxes board, inside a 44rem dialog: the box switcher stays the search row's lead, the multi-pick confirm and Pick none sit in the dock, the second-press confirm under the box.
- Bottle Cap, Ability Patch and Increase PP keep their layout (sprite, the choice, the status line, Use and Cancel) on the restyled primitives: radio rows become option cards like the move picker's.
- MovePicker rows take the catch sheet's move card look (type stripe, category, name).

inv-bag.text:
BAG: every element of InventoryList, ItemGrid, CandyGrid, ItemCard and BagHint has a place

Moved:
- Dialog (44rem) -> a 59rem sheet, so the pockets and a 6-wide tray sit side by side on every desktop.
- Pocket tabs (All, each kind the bag holds in ITEM_TYPE_ORDER with its count, a divider, Candies) -> a left rail of pockets, each with its colour; the open pocket is still remembered per device.
- 'About the bag' hint -> a ? at the sheet's top right.
- Search (type:berry is:usable), the 6×5 tray with count pills and gold price notes, empty squares, the pager -> the pocket's column, the pocket's name and stack count over it.
- Candies: the gold tray, no search, no pager, every pile.
- Press: a usable item opens Use it on, a relic its raid, an Escape Rope climbs out; then the teach, PP, Bottle Cap and Ability Patch dialogs, as today.
- Tooltip on pointing, as today.
- Dock: Close.

Proposal (Show proposals): pressing an item docks it on the right (art, count, pocket, price, description, the pokemon it would help) with its verb, Use it on…, in place of going straight to the picker. The sheet widens to 76rem for it.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-dex.text:
POKEDEX: every element of PokedexTab, PokedexGrid and SpeciesFormsDialog has a place

Moved:
- Dialog (44rem) -> a 59rem sheet with a rail, the size of the bag.
- Count badges (seen, caught, of total) -> two number tiles at the top of the rail.
- Region chips (name, seen/total, caught bar; a press turns to its first number) -> the rail, one row each.
- Find (a number turns to its page and rings it gold; a name finds only ones met) and All / Caught / Missing -> one row over the grid.
- Pager (earlier, '#001 – #030 · Kanto', later) -> between the find row and the grid.
- Grid (6×5, base forms only; unmet, seen as a silhouette, caught; still sprites; #NNN in the corner; every square a button) -> kept, larger squares.
- A press: forms first when the species has more than one, then the entry, as today. The forms dialog keeps its grid, 'n of m found' and Close.
- Dock: Close.

New: a key under the grid (caught, seen, not met).
Proposals (Show proposals): a mark on squares that have forms; a gold star on a region with everything caught.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-entry.text:
DEX ENTRY: every element of dex-entry-dialog (index, body) has a place

Moved:
- Bar (previous, '#NNN Name' or ???, category, types, seen and caught, next, close) -> a hero header like the catch sheet's, steps either side of the name.
- Portrait with its Regular / Shiny and ♂ / ♀ toggles -> the left column's stage.
- Height, weight, candy, hatch steps -> four tiles under it.
- Evolution line (stages, arrows with the method, other stages open their entry, its hint) -> a card filling the left column.
- Base stats (six bars, total), Abilities (plain, hidden, signature) and Habitat (lairs, biomes with hours, towns; extinct and none fallbacks) -> the centre column, each a card with its hint.
- Moves (Level, Machines, Egg tabs; level, type, category, name, power and PP; empty notes) -> the right column, scrolling in its card.
- Unmet: ??? and 'Meet this pokemon to fill in its entry.' across the two right columns; the silhouette stays.

'Show unmet' on the board only switches the board's example.
Dropped: nothing.

PHONE for all four: one column, the rail as a row of chips over the grid (as the box does today), cards stacked; drawn after these are agreed.
